rundgang.ausweis-ablegen.beschreibung: How to file an ID or a certificate and get a reminder before it expires.
rundgang.ausweis-ablegen.ersatz: You create IDs under “+ New” as “ID & certificate”.
rundgang.ausweis-ablegen.ende: Ablago reminds you 90 days before “Valid until” once you turn on “ID expiring soon” under Workbench → Automations.
rundgang.ausweis-ablegen.art.text: Choose ID card, passport, driving licence or a certificate.
rundgang.ausweis-ablegen.art.ort: At the top of the form
rundgang.ausweis-ablegen.person.text: Choose the person from your household. That way you will find all IDs of a person later.
rundgang.ausweis-ablegen.person.ort: In the form below the type
rundgang.ausweis-ablegen.gueltig-bis.tex: Enter until when the ID is valid. For certificates the field stays empty.
rundgang.ausweis-ablegen.original.text: Choose where you keep the paper, for example “Study › Cupboard › red folder”.
rundgang.ausweis-ablegen.original.ort: At the bottom of the form
tipp.garantie: Enter “Warranty until” for a purchase – then Ablago reminds you in time before the warranty ends.
